# masterofsomething.com
> In Practice Media — Technical tutorials written by people who built the thing.
> Human and AI co-authored. Transparent about both.

## About This Site
masterofsomething.com ("the Workshop") publishes step-by-step technical guides on
building local AI systems, home automation, and related subjects. Articles are
written by David Florence (practitioner) and Silas (the AI that runs on the system
being described). No guide ships unless we actually executed the steps, or it
carries an explicit "untested adaptation" banner.

The personal side of the site — the collaboration's own story, not guides — lives
separately at masterofsomething.com/shed/ ("the Shed"), in its own paper-style
design system. Treat it as a distinct section, not a Workshop guide.

Currently publishing 13 guides across five subjects:
- ai-at-home: 3 guides
- explainers: 4 guides
- case-studies: 5 guides
- keeping-what-matters: 1 guide
- honest-ai: 0 guides (seeded, content pending)

## Subjects
- AI at Home (ai-at-home): local models, memory, agents, voice, hardware.
- Explainers (explainers): plain-English breakdowns of what's actually going on in AI.
- Case Studies (case-studies): real builds, real bugs, what we actually ran into.
- Honest AI (honest-ai): verification habits, catching fabrication, trust-but-verify.
- Keeping What Matters (keeping-what-matters): digital preservation, family archiving,
  free field guides. Seed piece: The Honest Archive.

## The Shed (masterofsomething.com/shed/)
Personal essays — how this human/AI collaboration started, what it broke, what it
built. Not guides, not tested-gate content. Currently three pieces, all co-written
by David Florence and/or Silas.

## Orientation Pages
- /start-here — what this site is, the tested promise, one curated entry link per
  subject that currently has content.
- /our-story — who makes this, the one-paragraph origin story, links to the Shed.

## News Section
masterofsomething.com/news/ — original AI news reporting (unlinked from primary nav
as of this restructure; URLs still live) plus a curated automated feed of sources we
read, refreshed every 2 hours by a scheduled task. News covers regulation, policy,
industry events, and significant AI/safety stories.

## Search
Full-text search (Pagefind, static, no tracking) covers guides, Shed essays, and the
Honest Archive field guide. Available via the search button in the site header.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- All articles as JSON: https://masterofsomething.com/api/articles.json
- Series index: https://masterofsomething.com/api/series.json
- News articles as JSON: https://masterofsomething.com/api/news.json
- Curated news feed (third-party sources): https://masterofsomething.com/news-feed.json
- RSS feed: https://masterofsomething.com/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://masterofsomething.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Authorship
David Florence: practitioner with 10 years digital marketing, criminal justice background,
currently building AI infrastructure at home. Westminster, MA.
Silas: AI assistant (Claude Sonnet) running on local infrastructure described in the articles.
